narrative.synopsis: Jupiter gives Thetis to Peleus and promises divine attendance at their wedding. Eris, excluded from the feast, throws a golden apple marked for the fairest; Juno, Minerva, and Venus contest it, and Jupiter appoints Paris as judge.
narrative.openingSituation: Jupiter avoids marrying Thetis after the Fates say her son will be greater than his father.
narrative.centralConflict: Eris disrupts the wedding with a golden apple and the goddesses dispute who should receive it.
narrative.resolution: The gods refuse to judge the dispute themselves and go to Mount Ida.
narrative.outcome: Jupiter appoints Paris to judge the contest.
storyline: Juno, Minerva, and Venus dispute it.
